text:
BIG-IP LTM v14.1.0
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 14.1.0
ACCESS::saml
- allows you to retrieve or
manipulate SAML related messages
ANTIFRAUD::disable_injection
- disables Anti-Fraud injections for the current transaction.
ANTIFRAUD::enable_log
- enables
Anti-Fraud TMM logs for the current transaction
BOTDEFENSE::bot_anomalies
-
returns the list of names of anomalies detected for the client
that sent the current request
BOTDEFENSE::bot_categories
-
returns the list of category names to which the current client belongs
BOTDEFENSE::bot_name
-
returns the name assigned to the detected bot, browser or mobile application
BOTDEFENSE::client_class
-
returns the classification of the client based on the current
request and its browsing history
BOTDEFENSE::intent
-
returns the intent found for the bot that sent the current request
BOTDEFENSE::micro_service
-
returns the micro-service that matched the current request
DIAMETER::is_retransmission
- returns true if the current message is a retransmitted request
DIAMETER::retransmission
-
allows the setting or getting of the current message’s
retransmission settings
DIAMETER::retransmission_default
- gets or sets the current connection’s retransmission settings
DIAMETER::retransmission_reason
- returns the reason the current request was retransmitted
DIAMETER::retransmit
- triggers
the request associated to the current answer message for
retransmission
FLOW::create_related
- creates a
related connection between clientside and serverside
FLOW::idle_duration
- returns the
time in seconds when the flow was last used.
FLOW::idle_timeout
- Sets/Gets the
idle timeout on the flow
FLOW::peer
- returns the TCL flow handle for
the peer flow
FLOW::refresh
- updates the last used
time on the flow to now
FLOW::this
- returns the TCL handle for the
current flow
HTTP2::disable
- changes the HTTP2
filter from full parsing to passthrough mode
HTTP2::enable
- changes the HTTP2 filter
from passthrough to full parsing mode
HTTP2::push
- accepts a resource as a
parameter that can be pushed to the client using PUSH_PROMISE
frames
LB::enable_decisionlog
- enables
LTM decision logging
MR::return
- returns the current message to
the originating connection
SCTP::rto_initial
- returns the
initial value of SCTP retranmission timeout
SCTP::rto_max
- returns the maximum value
of SCTP retranmission timeout
SCTP::rto_min
- returns the minimum value
of SCTP retranmission timeout
SCTP::sack_timeout
- returns the
SCTP’s delayed selective acknowledgement timeout
UDP::hold
- holds back processing of input
packets until UDP::release is called
UDP::release
- allows client-side ingress
to flow following a call to UDP::hold
XLAT::listen
- creates a related ephemeral
listener
XLAT::listen_lifetime
- sets/gets
the listener lifetime
XLAT::src_addr
- returns the string
representation of the source translation address
XLAT::src_config
- returns the source
translation configuration as a list
XLAT::src_endpoint_reservation
- create, update, or get reserved entry values
XLAT::src_nat_valid_range
-
returns a list of lists containing valid source-translation
addresses and port-ranges
XLAT::src_port
- returns the source
translation port
Commands Updated in BIG-IP LTM 14.1.0
DIAMETER::persist
- returns the
persistence key being used for the current message
FLOW::priority
- used to overwrite the
flow’s internal packet priority
MR::message
- returns or sets details in
the message routing table
TCP::congestion
- sets the TCP
congestion control algorithm
Events Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 14.1.0
ACCESS_SAML_ASSERTION
- triggered
when the SAML assertion payload is generated for a user session.
ACCESS_SAML_AUTHN
- triggered when
the SAML authentication request payload is generated for a user
session.
ACCESS_SAML_SLO_REQ
- triggered
when the SAML single logout request payload is generated for a
user session.
ACCESS_SAML_SLO_RESP
- triggered
when the SAML single logout response payload is generated for a
user session
DIAMETER_RETRANSMISSION
-
triggered when the generates a retransmitted DIAMETER request or a
DIAMETER answer message
SA_PICKED
- triggered after source
translation is completed.
